task: Draft a required-disclosure footer for a fictional financial-planning service's marketing page. Marketing is the primary genre; apply legal safeguards. Include only the supplied disclosure facts. Do not add regulatory citations, investment advice, or performance claims.

facts.text: The fictional financial-planning service is offered by Carmel Wealth Advisory.
Carmel Wealth Advisory is not described as a registered investment adviser in the supplied facts.
The marketing page is informational only and does not constitute investment advice.
Past performance does not guarantee future results.
